units: USD per million tokens, Anthropic API list rates
match: a transcript model id matches a key exactly, or the key plus a -YYYYMMDD date suffix; anything else is reported as unpriced
verified: true: the row reproduced Claude Code's own costUSD for this model on a recorded session; the source names the rates that session exercised. false: the rates come from published docs only, and reports mark that model's lines as an estimate

claude-opus-5-5.source: docs: input, output, cache read; cache writes at the standard 1.25x / 2x of input. Not checked against Claude Code

claude-opus-5.source: reproduces Claude Code's costUSD on a recorded session (tests/fixtures, 2026-10-22): input, 5m and 1h cache writes, cache read, output

claude-sonnet-5-5.source: docs: input, output, cache read; same rates as claude-sonnet-5. Not checked against Claude Code

claude-sonnet-5.source: reproduces Claude Code's costUSD on a recorded session (tests/fixtures, 2026-10-22): input, 5m cache write, cache read, output; the 1h write rate is the standard 2x input, not exercised

claude-haiku-5-5.source: docs: input and output per tier; cache at the standard 1.25x / 2x / 0.1x of input. Not checked against Claude Code

claude-haiku-4-5.source: reproduces Claude Code's costUSD on a recorded session (2026-10-22): input and output only; cache rates at the standard 1.25x / 2x / 0.1x of input, not exercised

claude-fable-5-1.source: docs: input, output, cache read; cache writes at the standard 1.25x / 2x of input. Not checked against Claude Code

claude-mythos-5-1.source: docs: same pricing as claude-fable-5-1. Not checked against Claude Code

ceiling.note: Read by hooks/cap-model.sh (its DEFAULT_CEILING copy is kept equal by a test). Effort per call is the Agent call's effort if it has one, else the effort: of the named sharaqi agent file.

context.note: Read by scripts/tokens.py --context, which hooks/context-gate.sh runs. The window is verified only from the statusline bridge file; fallback_window only labels an estimate.
